labels.shortDescription: Instant totals: section title on the Rollup Builder
labels.value: Instant Totals

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals: what the section lists
labels.value: The objects your instant rollups count, and whether saving one of their records updates the totals at once.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals status: BarnCRM ships the trigger
labels.value: Instant: BarnCRM updates these totals by itself.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals status: trigger on. {0} is the trigger name.
labels.value: On: the trigger {0} updates these totals at once.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals status: switched off
labels.value: Turned off: these totals update every night and when you click Recalculate.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals status: inactive in Setup. {0} is the trigger name.
labels.value: Inactive: the trigger {0} was deactivated in Setup. Activate it in a sandbox and deploy it again, or remove it.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals status: no trigger yet
labels.value: Not set up: these totals update every night and when you click Recalculate.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals status: no trigger allowed on the object
labels.value: Salesforce allows no trigger on this object: these totals update every night and when you click Recalculate.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals: rollups counting the object. {0} is the count.
labels.value: {0} instant rollups count this object.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals: one rollup counts the object
labels.value: 1 instant rollup counts this object.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals: no rollup counts the object any more
labels.value: No instant rollup counts this object any more. Turn the trigger off or remove it.

labels.shortDescription: Instant totals: setup steps title. {0} is the object label.
labels.value: Turn On Instant Totals for {0}

labels.shortDescription: Setup step 1. {0} is the trigger name, {1} the object API name.
labels.value: In a sandbox (or a Developer Edition org) where BarnCRM is installed, open the Developer Console. Choose File, New, Apex Trigger, name it {0}, pick the object {1}, replace the code with the trigger below and save.

labels.shortDescription: Setup step 2. {0} is the test class name.
labels.value: Choose File, New, Apex Class, name it {0}, replace the code with the test below and save. Run it from Test, New Run: it passes.

labels.shortDescription: Setup step 3. {0} is the trigger name, {1} the test class name.
labels.value: In the sandbox's Setup, open Outbound Change Sets, add the trigger {0} and the class {1}, and upload the change set to production.

labels.shortDescription: Setup step 4. {0} is the test class name.
labels.value: In production's Setup, open Inbound Change Sets, click Deploy, choose Run specified tests and enter {0}. Only that test runs, so tests elsewhere in your org do not block it.

labels.shortDescription: Setup step 5: come back and see On
labels.value: Back in the Rollup Builder, this object shows On as soon as the trigger is in the org.

labels.shortDescription: Removal step 1: turning off needs no deploy
labels.value: To stop instant totals now, use Turn off instant totals: nothing is deployed, it works in production at once, and you can turn it back on.

labels.shortDescription: Removal step 2. {0} is the trigger name, {1} the test class name.
labels.value: To delete it, for example before uninstalling BarnCRM: in a sandbox, delete the trigger {0} and the class {1} in Setup (Apex Triggers, Apex Classes).
